annotations.title: Build swap: approve + swap txs, simulated

description: One call to get everything needed to swap through BlazarFeeRouter: ordered txs[] (exact approve if needed, then swap), a plain-English summary per tx, an eth_call simulation of the swap (as if the approve were mined), the quote used, guards (minAmountOut, 3-minute deadline) and warnings[]. Use this instead of blazar_quote + blazar_decode_tx + blazar_simulate_tx. Only swaps built here (through BlazarFeeRouter) earn BZB trading rewards. Returns UNSIGNED txs; nothing is sent. Polygon only (chain 137).

amount.description: Amount of tokenIn in HUMAN units, not wei: "1.5" = 1.5 POL, "250" = 250 BZB. Set amountIsBaseUnits=true to pass wei/base units instead.

amountIsBaseUnits.description: If true, amount is in base units (wei for 18-decimal tokens; 6 decimals for USDC). Default false.

deadlineSeconds.description: Seconds until the swap expires. Default 150; the fee router caps it at 180.

from.description: Address that will sign and send the txs. Required: used for allowance checks, simulation and nonce.

maxPriceImpactBps.description: Refuse with INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY above this impact. Default 3000 (30%).

recipient.description: Who receives the output. Defaults to `from`.

slippageBps.description: Max slippage in basis points (50 = 0.5%). Default 50, max 300.

tokenIn.description: Token to sell: symbol (POL, WPOL, BZB, USDC, USDT, WETH, WBTC) or its listed 0x address (see blazar_tokens). "POL" is the native gas token; WPOL is the ERC-20.

tokenOut.description: Token to buy: symbol (POL, WPOL, BZB, USDC, USDT, WETH, WBTC) or its listed 0x address. Choose "POL" to receive native POL (auto-unwrapped).

name: blazar_build_swap

outputSchema.description: One-call build: ordered UNSIGNED txs, simulation, guards and warnings. Nothing is signed or sent.

batch.description: EIP-5792 wallet_sendCalls request with the same calls (smart wallets).
